excludedRows.name: Pen
excludedRows.reason: The source calls Pen removed and says it was replaced by Tinted Glasses. Parent approval excludes removed items from the title count unless a removed-items section is re-approved.

notes: Snowball is counted as current/public after the fresh source check because the current Items page lists it in public-server items and describes a shop/spawn route.
Private-server-only rows are included only with explicit private-server labels.
Sniper and Transfigured Human are left without images because no clean row-specific local image was obtained during this pass.

sectionOrder: Public shop, spawn, and map items

items.name: Soda
items.catalogSection: Public shop, spawn, and map items
items.source: Vending machines or separate shop Soda purchase
items.price: $5 from vending machines or the shop Soda purchase
items.effect: Drinks Soda to restore HP and evasion; under 25 HP, the user crushes the can and can throw it with M1.
items.damageHeal: Restores HP and evasion to full over a few seconds; regeneration stops if the user is attacked.
items.usesBreakRule: Consumed after drinking; the low-HP thrown can can be picked up and thrown repeatedly until it despawns.
items.storageDropDespawn: Can be carried or stored by Ten Shadows before use; thrown cans follow pickup and despawn behavior.
items.location: Vending machines and shop Soda purchase route
items.verificationNote: Current source lists Soda as a $5 vending/shop item that restores HP and evasion to full over a few seconds, stops if attacked, and creates a throwable can under 25 HP.

items.name: Jet Black
items.catalogSection: Public shop, spawn, and map items
items.source: Shop item delivery or timed map spawns
items.price: $10 through shop item delivery when available
items.effect: Replaces M1 attacks with dagger slashes and knocks enemies back on the final slash.
items.damageHeal: Regular M1 string damage; final slash adds knockback
items.usesBreakRule: Reusable while held
items.storageDropDespawn: Can be stored by Ten Shadows; drops when the holder is hit and despawns if left unclaimed.
items.location: Shop item delivery pool and map item spawns
items.verificationNote: Source-backed role and storage/drop rules checked on 2026-05-31.

items.name: Playful Cloud
items.catalogSection: Public shop, spawn, and map items
items.source: Shop item delivery or timed map spawns
items.price: $10 through shop item delivery when available
items.effect: Replaces M1 attacks with a 5-hit Playful Cloud combo that scales higher when the user's HP is low.
items.damageHeal: 18 damage full combo; scales up to +115% at low HP; broken pieces deal 8 damage each.
items.usesBreakRule: Drops only after ragdoll; breaks after 15 M1 sets or by M1 while blocking, splitting into two throwable pieces.
items.storageDropDespawn: Can be stored by Ten Shadows; drops when the holder is hit and despawns if left unclaimed.
items.location: Shop item delivery pool and map item spawns
items.verificationNote: Source lists 18 full-combo damage, low-HP scaling up to +115%, ragdoll-only drops, and break behavior after 15 M1 sets.

items.name: Transfigured Human
items.catalogSection: Public shop, spawn, and map items
items.source: Created by Perfection's base Focus Strike finisher
items.price: No Cash cost
items.effect: Throws a Transfigured Human that morphs into a random-sized NPC and fights nearby targets.
items.damageHeal: Damage value not listed; moveset depends on the Transfigured Human's size.
items.usesBreakRule: Disappears if no target is nearby; can target dummies, players, and other Transfigured Humans.
items.storageDropDespawn: Can be stored by Perfection with special while held, puked out with block plus M1, or used as a Soul Fire bullet with a chance to summon on miss.
items.location: Created through Perfection's Focus Strike finisher route
items.imageMissingReason: No clean row-specific Transfigured Human image appears on the current Items source; left blank instead of using Transfigured Flesh or Perfection art as a weak substitute.
items.verificationNote: Source describes the Focus Strike finisher route, NPC target behavior, Perfection storage, Soul Fire bullet chance, and lack of a clean row-specific image.
